author: Bertrand Russell
title: The Problems of Philosophy
edition: London: Williams and Norgate; New York: Henry Holt and Co., 1912, Home University Library of Modern Knowledge. Scan-backed Wikisource transcription. Prose line wrapping is collapsed within retained paragraphs; HTML emphasis becomes plain text. Printed page numbers, navigation, footnote reference markers, and zero-width page-boundary characters are omitted; main-text wording and punctuation are retained. Original verse line breaks are preserved where present. Apparent errors present in the linked transcription are retained rather than silently corrected; this extraction check is not a fresh complete print-image collation. The library text holds Russell's Preface, Chapters I to XV with their printed numbers and titles, and the Bibliographical Note; the series title page, imprint, contents and the book's index are omitted, and so is the author's single footnote.

rights.basis: This original English edition was published in 1912, before 1931, and is public domain in the United States as of 2026. The linked scan index identifies the printed edition; no modern editorial material is supplied.

acquisition.method: Wikisource rendered page HTML (index.php action=render) for the main page and its sixteen subpages in printed order: The Problems of Philosophy (for the Preface), /Chapter 1 to /Chapter 15 and /Bibliographical Note (revisions 10776472, 4983373, 4983681, 4983679, 4986625, 4987838, 4987971, 4995436, 11514645, 4996131, 4996387, 4996412, 4997116, 4997120, 4997136, 4997141, 4995648); downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the seventeen responses concatenated in that order and downloadUrl the first of them. Only the transcluded scan text is used: Wikisource headers, page-number anchors, footnote markers and lists and zero-width page-boundary characters removed; the title page, imprint and contents of the main page dropped; centred titles became headings; paragraphs and bibliography entries joined with whitespace collapsed; emphasis flattened.
